---
mode: ask
description: Draft an architecture decision record in the house format.
---

Write an ADR for the decision I describe. Use the template in `docs/adr/0000-template.md`.

Rules:

- Context states the forces, not the conclusion.
- List at least two options that were genuinely considered, with their downsides.
- Consequences include what becomes harder, not only what becomes easier.
- Status starts as `Proposed`.
- No marketing language. A future engineer should understand why we had no better option.
